es: Reconocer cómo el pasado y el pasado continuo suavizan una petición (I was wondering if…, I was hoping…) y ordenar peticiones de la más directa a la más distante.

teaching.en: I was wondering if you could spare a few minutes this afternoon, because I'd like to go over the report with you.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si podrías dedicarme unos minutos esta tarde, porque me gustaría repasar el informe contigo.
teaching.explanationEs: I was wondering if + could: el pasado continuo crea distancia y la petición suena tentativa, aunque pidas algo para hoy.
segments: I was wondering if you could spare a few minutes this
afternoon, because I'd like to go over the report with you.
teaching.audioText: I was wondering if you could spare a few minutes this afternoon, because I'd like to go over the report with you.

teaching.en: Would you mind lending me your notes? I was hoping you could do me a favour before the exam on Friday.
teaching.es: ¿Te importaría prestarme tus apuntes? Esperaba que pudieras hacerme un favor antes del examen del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Would you mind va seguido de -ing; I was hoping suaviza igual que I was wondering y habla de ahora, no de ayer.
segments: Would you mind lending me your notes? I was hoping you
could do me a favour before the exam on Friday.
teaching.audioText: Would you mind lending me your notes? I was hoping you could do me a favour before the exam on Friday.

teaching.en: I hate to impose, but could I borrow your car, at your convenience, for a couple of hours this weekend?
teaching.es: No quisiera abusar, pero ¿podría pedirte prestado el coche, cuando te venga bien, un par de horas este fin de semana?
teaching.explanationEs: I hate to impose reconoce que pides un esfuerzo; at your convenience deja que el otro elija el momento.
segments: I hate to impose, but could I borrow your car,
at your convenience, for a couple of hours this weekend?
teaching.audioText: I hate to impose, but could I borrow your car, at your convenience, for a couple of hours this weekend?

teaching.en: A direct request like 'Lend me your pen' can sound abrupt, so speakers soften it by using could, might or a verb in the past.
teaching.es: Una petición directa como «Préstame tu bolígrafo» puede sonar brusca, así que los hablantes la suavizan con un tiempo pasado y un verbo modal.
teaching.explanationEs: Soften es rebajar la fuerza de la petición: could, might y el pasado continuo son los recursos habituales.
segments: A direct request like 'Lend me your pen' can sound abrupt, so speakers
soften it by using could, might or a verb in the past.
teaching.audioText: A direct request like 'Lend me your pen' can sound abrupt, so speakers soften it by using could, might or a verb in the past.

teaching.en: Her tone was tentative rather than demanding, which is why the request came across as polite instead of forceful.
teaching.es: Su tono era tentativo y no exigente, por eso la petición dio la impresión de ser cortés y no autoritaria.
teaching.explanationEs: Tentative describe lo que no se afirma con rotundidad; come across as indica la impresión que causa el mensaje.
segments: Her tone was tentative rather than demanding, which is why
the request came across as polite instead of forceful.
teaching.audioText: Her tone was tentative rather than demanding, which is why the request came across as polite instead of forceful.

teaching.en: With tact, you can make a request sound like a suggestion, so nobody feels pressured, even though you still want an answer.
teaching.es: Con tacto puedes hacer que una petición suene a sugerencia, de modo que nadie se sienta presionado, aunque sigas queriendo una respuesta.
teaching.explanationEs: Tact es la delicadeza de pedir sin presionar: dejas una salida al otro, pero la petición sigue en pie.

so nobody feels pressured, even though you still want an answer.

prompt.es: Lee el correo y elige qué efecto tiene «I was wondering if» en la petición.

choices.text: It makes the request tentative without moving it into the past.
It tells Mr Reed that she asked him the same thing before.
It turns the request into a polite order that he must follow.

feedback.es: El pasado continuo de wondering solo suaviza: la autora pide ahora, pero deja a Mr Reed libre para decir que no.

hint.es: Piensa en qué hace el tiempo verbal: crea distancia, no un pasado real.

origin.text: Dear Mr Reed, I hate to impose, but I was wondering if you could read my draft at your convenience. There is no rush at all.

prompt.es: Completa: «Odio abusar de ti, pero esperaba que me dedicaras unos minutos.»

feedback.es: Impose on someone significa abusar de su tiempo o de su amabilidad; I hate to impose prepara la petición que viene después.

hint.es: Es el verbo que se usa para molestar o abusar de la amabilidad de alguien.

origin.text: I hate to ___ on you, but I was hoping you could spare a few minutes before the meeting.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Te importaría prestarme tus apuntes cuando te venga bien?»

answer.text: Would you mind lending me your notes at your convenience

feedback.es: Would you mind exige -ing (lending), y at your convenience cierra la frase dejando elegir el momento al otro.

hint.es: Empieza por Would you mind y termina con la fórmula que cede el momento.

prompt.es: Escucha el pódcast y elige por qué la jefa usa «I was wondering if».

choices.text: To show her team that she has already asked for the figures.
To make her requests sound tentative, so nobody feels pressured.
To delay the figures until her team has more time to prepare.

feedback.es: La presentadora descubre que el pasado solo sirve para sonar tentativa: nadie se siente presionado y, curiosamente, el equipo trabaja más rápido.

origin.audio: In a podcast about good manners at work, the host explains that her manager never gives orders. Instead of saying, Send me the figures, she says, I was wondering if you could send me the figures when you get a chance. At first the host thought the past tense meant that her manager had already asked, but she soon realised that it was only a way of sounding tentative, so that nobody felt pressured. She adds that, curiously, the team works faster now, because the requests never feel like commands.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con el efecto que tiene en la petición.

pairs.es: Deja elegir el momento al otro
Suaviza con un tiempo de distancia

feedback.es: Cada fórmula cumple una función distinta: reconocer el esfuerzo, ceder el momento, crear distancia con el pasado o, sin suavizar, dar una orden.

pairs.es: Deja elegir el momento al otro
Suaviza con un tiempo de distancia

prompt.es: Lee el correo. ¿Qué hace la autora con «do not feel you have to say yes»?

choices.text: She reminds Sam that he promised to help her earlier.
She pretends the request is optional while hoping for a yes.
She gives Sam a polite way out of the request.

feedback.es: La frase le ofrece a Sam una salida: pedir con tacto es reconocer que el otro puede negarse, sin reproche ni presión.

origin.text: Hi Sam, I was wondering whether you'd mind having a look at my proposal before Friday. I know it is a lot to ask, so please do not feel you have to say yes. If you are too busy, I will ask someone else.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de voz y elige qué da a entender Mia sobre su petición.

choices.text: She wants help soon but is ready to fit around Tom's schedule.
She is stuck and expects Tom to clear tomorrow for her.
She is offering to take over part of Tom's launch work in return.

feedback.es: Mia pide ayuda para mañana, pero ofrece el jueves y deja a Tom decidir: quiere la ayuda sin imponer su calendario.

origin.audio: Hi Tom, it's Mia. I was wondering if you could spare ten minutes tomorrow, because I'm a bit stuck with the budget. I know you're busy with the launch, so if it's easier, we could do it on Thursday instead. Honestly, I'd hate to impose, so just tell me if it's a bad time. Anyway, let me know when you can.

prompt.es: Con el mismo mensaje, elige con qué propósito dice Mia «I'd hate to impose».

choices.text: To hint that the budget problem is more urgent than she admits.
To let Tom refuse without feeling bad about it.
To thank Tom in advance for agreeing to help tomorrow.

feedback.es: I'd hate to impose prepara el «no» de Tom: Mia le deja claro que puede rechazar la petición sin que ella se ofenda.

origin.audio: Hi Tom, it's Mia. I was wondering if you could spare ten minutes tomorrow, because I'm a bit stuck with the budget. I know you're busy with the launch, so if it's easier, we could do it on Thursday instead. Honestly, I'd hate to impose, so just tell me if it's a bad time. Anyway, let me know when you can.

prompt.es: Completa: «Usó «I was wondering» para suavizar una petición brusca.»

feedback.es: Soften significa rebajar la fuerza de una petición brusca; aquí el pasado continuo y could cumplen esa función sin cambiar lo que se pide.

origin.text: Her email opened with 'I was wondering if you could…' to ___ an otherwise abrupt demand, so that nobody would feel pressured.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Esperaba que pudieras dedicarme unos minutos hoy.»

answer.text: I was hoping you might spare a few minutes today

feedback.es: I was hoping abre la petición con distancia, might la hace aún más tentativa y spare significa dedicar tiempo.

prompt.es: Lee el correo. ¿Qué deja entrever el autor sobre el plazo que le han dado?

choices.text: He accepts it gladly and sees nothing to discuss.
He thinks it unfair and refuses to begin the work.
He finds it tight but does not openly complain.

feedback.es: I was hoping we could discuss y my team is already very stretched insinúan que el plazo es ajustado, sin quejarse abiertamente.

origin.text: Dear Ms Lopez, thank you for your message. I'd be glad to help, but I was hoping we could discuss the deadline first, since my team is already very stretched. Would it be possible to meet on Wednesday?

prompt.es: Escucha la escena y elige qué tono tiene la petición del cliente.

choices.text: Polite and low-key, with no pressure on the waiter.
Nervous and shy, as if he expected a refusal.
Irritated and sarcastic, hiding a complaint about the music.

feedback.es: Excuse me, I was wondering y if you'd mind dan una petición cortés y tranquila; el cliente no presiona y la respuesta es amable.

origin.audio: At the café, a customer turns to the waiter and says, Excuse me, I was wondering if you'd mind turning the music down a little, because I'm trying to finish a call. The waiter nods and answers, Of course, I was about to do that myself. The customer smiles and goes back to his laptop.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Podría pedirte un favor? No es urgente.»

feedback.es: Ask someone a favour es la colocación habitual para pedir ayuda, y aclarar que no es urgente suaviza todavía más la petición.

origin.text: Could I ask you a ___? It is nothing urgent, so please take your time.
